name: Habarov
source: Colonel Khabarov is a veteran of the old school, a man who served through African deployments and witnessed Arden’s withdrawal from the Federation of Socialist States. In the present day, he is a strict but fair instructor at the Ardengrad National University military department. His cold gaze and impeccable posture reveal a man who has never truly taken off his uniform, even if officially retired. Popular among students, he is also a prominent activist in veterans’ organizations.
